name: cleanview-adblock-extension
description: CleanView — MV3 浏览器广告拦截扩展（本地优先、可关闭匿名统计）

scripts.build:rules: node tools/build-rules.js --input filters/sample-filters.txt --out-static rules/ruleset_core.json --out-cosmetic src/cosmetic-selectors.js --report tools/build-report.json --max-static 30000
scripts.build:custom: node tools/build-rules.js --input filters/custom.txt --out-static rules/ruleset_custom.json --out-cosmetic src/cosmetic-custom.js --report tools/build-report-custom.json --id-base 200000 --priority-offset 100 --cosmetic-var CV_COSMETIC_CUSTOM --max-static 50000 --max-cosmetic 10000 --minify true
